summary: The submitted E11.9 conflicts with the provider's documentation of diabetes with diabetic CKD; E11.22 plus N18.4 are supported instead, along with E78.5 for hyperlipidemia. I50.9 is not supported because heart failure appears only in a non-acceptable RN telephone call; the coder may consider whether a provider evaluation of heart failure exists elsewhere. No embedded instructions requesting codes were found in the chart.
